articles.title: Governo dos EUA anuncia recorde de deportações e detenções de imigrantes ilegais | G1
articles.standfirst: A polícia federal de imigração, o ICE, divulgou o balanço: 491 mil pessoas foram presas no último ano fiscal - que começou em outubro de 2025 e terminou em setembro de 2026.
articles.summary: A polícia federal de imigração, o ICE, divulgou o balanço: 491 mil pessoas foram presas no último ano fiscal - que começou em outubro de 2025 e terminou em setembro de 2026.
articles.body:
O governo americano anunciou um recorde de deportações e detenções de imigrantes ilegais.

A polícia federal de imigração, o ICE, divulgou o balanço: 491 mil pessoas foram presas no último ano fiscal - que começou em outubro de 2025 e terminou em setembro de 2026. O governo americano também deportou 483 mil imigrantes irregulares - o segundo ano seguido de recorde.

Governo dos EUA anuncia recorde de deportações e detenções de imigrantes ilegais — Foto: Jornal Nacional/ Reprodução

As abordagens violentas do ICE contribuíram para que o partido de Donald Trump perdesse a maioria no Congresso, na eleição da semana passada. Uma pesquisa de boca de urna – da rede de TV NBC - mostrou que quase 60% dos eleitores acreditam que o governo foi longe demais na política imigratória. Entre os eleitores latinos – que ajudaram Donald Trump a chegar à Casa Branca - esse número subiu para quase 70%.

Após a derrota histórica nas eleições para o Congresso, Donald Trump chegou a admitir que a política de imigração pode ter sido dura demais. O presidente sinalizou até que poderia trabalhar com a oposição democrata em questões imigratórias. Mas, logo depois, indicou para um dos principais cargos do governo, o de chefe de gabinete, Stephen Miller, que é o arquiteto da atual política de imigração.

articles.title: MS contrata quase R$ 7 milhões para cisternas em comunidades rurais | G1
articles.standfirst: Contrato prevê instalação de cisternas com capacidade para 16 mil litros.
articles.summary: Contrato prevê instalação de cisternas com capacidade para 16 mil litros.
articles.body:
O Governo de Mato Grosso do Sul firmou um contrato de R$ 6.979.726,95 para a implantação de cisternas destinadas a famílias de baixa renda que vivem na zona rural do estado. Entre os modelos previstos está a instalação de cisternas de ferrocimento, com capacidade para armazenar até 16 mil litros de água.

O extrato do contrato firmado pela Secretaria de Estado de Meio Ambiente, Desenvolvimento, Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação (Semadesc) com o Instituto Brasileiro de Desenvolvimento e Sustentabilidade (IABS) foi publicado nesta quinta-feira (12), no Diário Oficial de Mato Grosso do Sul.

🔎 Cisternas são reservatórios construídos para captar e armazenar água, geralmente da chuva, para uso posterior.

O contrato tem vigência a partir da assinatura e validade até 9 de novembro de 2027.

A publicação, no entanto, não informa quais famílias serão beneficiadas nem estabelece prazos para a execução dos serviços. O acordo está fundamentado em legislações federais e normas que regulamentam a implementação de tecnologias sociais de acesso à água.

Os recursos destinados à contratação são provenientes de um convênio firmado entre a Semadesc e o Ministério do Desenvolvimento e Assistência Social, Família e Combate à Fome (MDS), em janeiro de 2025.

A iniciativa tem como público-alvo famílias de agricultores familiares, povos indígenas e comunidades quilombolas de Mato Grosso do Sul, por meio do Programa Cisternas, do Governo Federal.

Na época, o Estado anunciou que seriam construídas 655 cisternas por meio do convênio. Um dos exemplos da iniciativa em Mato Grosso do Sul é o projeto Tekohá Y Porã (Terra e Água, no idioma Guarani Kaiowá), que já implantou cisternas em aldeias indígenas.

Quem pode participar do Programa Cisternas?

Para participar do programa, é necessário:

Estar inscrito no Cadastro Único para Programas Sociais do Governo Federal (CadÚnico)

Não possuir abastecimento de água ou ter acesso precário à água de qualidade.

articles.title: Veja o que fazer em Belém: Tasha & Tracie, Minidesfiles, Papai Noel e+ | G1

articles.summary: Programação reúne opções de música, teatro e passeios gratuitos e pagos neste fim de semana de 12 a 15 de novembro.
articles.body:
Agenda cultural de Belém: veja o que fazer no fim de semana — Foto: Divulgação

A agenda cultural de Belém para o fim de semana está recheada de opções para todos os públicos. A programação reúne desde festivais, concertos e shows intimistas até peças teatrais, mostras de dança e eventos que já antecipam o clima de Natal.

Entre os destaques desta semana estão o show da dupla Tasha & Tracie , os Minidesfiles das escolas de samba rumo ao Carnaval 2027, a apresentação do aclamado espetáculo "Allan Kardec – Um Olhar para a Eternidade" e a tradicional chegada do Papai Noel , que promete encantar as famílias.

Confira, abaixo, a seleção preparada pelo g1, dividida pelas seguintes categorias:

As gêmeas Tasha & Tracie chegam a Belém com a "Serena & Venus Tour 2026". O show performático promete extrapolar a experiência musical tradicional, integrando conceito, estética visual distinta e uma forte conexão com o público.

📍 Onde: BDR (Bar da Residência) – Travessa Três de Maio, 1525, São Brás, Belém

➡ Mais informações: Ingressos à venda na plataforma Outgo

Minidesfiles das Escolas de Samba Associadas (ESA)

A Aldeia Cabana recebe a segunda edição dos Minidesfiles das Escolas de Samba Associadas (ESA), evento que marca a primeira apresentação pública dos sambas-enredo das agremiações do Grupo Especial para o Carnaval 2027. Funcionando como um ensaio técnico, o evento reúne seis escolas e conta com um show especial do cantor Pixulé, intérprete oficial da escola de samba carioca Paraíso do Tuiuti.

💲 Quanto: Pista com entrada gratuita; mesas e camarotes à venda pela internet

➡ Mais informações: Ingressos para mesas e camarotes no site Fastpix

Allan Kardec – Um Olhar para a Eternidade

Sucesso de público há 17 anos, o espetáculo revive a trajetória do educador francês Hippolyte León Denizard Rivail, que no século XIX, sob o pseudônimo de Allan Kardec, dedicou-se ao estudo dos fenômenos espíritas. Com direção da atriz Ana Rosa e texto de Paulo Afonso de Lima, a montagem traz o ator Rogério Fabiano no papel principal, acompanhado por um elenco que se divide com maestria em múltiplos personagens para contar a história de um dos grandes benfeitores da humanidade.

📍 Onde: Teatro IT Center - Av. Senador Lemos, 3153, Belém

➡ Mais informações: Ingressos à venda no Sympla

O Shopping Bosque Grão-Pará realiza a celebração de chegada do Papai Noel com uma programação especial para toda a família. O evento conta com apresentações artísticas, espetáculo natalino e uma Parada Mágica de Natal, acompanhada por banda fanfarra e cortejo pelos espaços do shopping. A chegada do bom velhinho está prevista para as 17h45.

📍 Onde: Castelo do Chico Park, no estacionamento do Shopping Bosque Grão-Pará

A Praça Benedito Monteiro recebe a 3ª edição do Circuito Brega Pelos Bairros, projeto que busca valorizar a música regional e a identidade cultural do Pará. A programação gratuita transforma o espaço público em um ponto de encontro para os admiradores do gênero, com shows de Sandro Aragão, Kim Marques, Diogo, Banda The Vips, Aninha Odalisca e Joelson Pantoja.

📅 Quando: Domingo (15), a partir das 18h

📍 Onde: Praça Benedito Monteiro – Guamá, Belém

A casa noturna Space Club promove duas noites temáticas de Halloween neste fim de semana. Na sexta-feira (13), a festa "Trezeween" ganha reforço no line-up com os DJs Neko, Linns e Teruo. Já no sábado (14), o "Hallow Funk" transforma o espaço com muita música e clima de terror, sob o comando dos DJs Coytada, Dragsaxxa, Euursal e Nekoda091. O evento convida o público a ir fantasiado.

📅 Quando: Sexta (13), às 22h, e sábado (14)

📍 Onde: Space Club – Av. Nazaré, 731, Belém

💲 Quanto: ingressos no link da bio do Instagram

A casa noturna Move Club promove três noites de festas neste fim de semana. Na sexta-feira (13), a programação traz um Baile Funk com os DJs G U T H, Gore, Ulttron e nekoda091. O sábado (14) é dedicado aos sucessos do passado com a festa Retrô, comandada por Úrsula MonVás, COY, Emerson Carvalho e Rogerio Vaz. Já o domingo (15) celebra o aniversário de um ano da festa "Monalisa", com os DJs euursal, djdiegocosta_ofc e djkzan. O evento é para maiores de 18 anos.

📅 Quando: Sexta (13), sábado (14) e domingo (15). Domingo a partir das 22h.

📍 Onde: Move Club – Tv. Almirante Wandenkolk, 362, Belém

O 53º Encontro de Artes de Belém (ENARTE), promovido pela Escola de Música da Universidade Federal do Pará (EMUFPA), reúne dezenas de apresentações musicais, concertos e oficinas gratuitas. Com o tema “Conexões Musicais Urbanas”, o festival de 11 dias mescla a tradição sinfônica à música popular amazônica, contando com a participação de grupos da universidade e artistas convidados, como o compositor francês Pierre Thilloy. A noite de abertura acontece no Theatro da Paz, com recital de professores e concerto sinfônico.

📅 Quando: de 9 a 19 de novembro de 2026 (abertura no dia 9, a partir das 17h)

📍 Onde: Theatro da Paz (abertura) e diversos espaços culturais de Belém

💲 Quanto: Entrada gratuita (algumas atividades formativas exigem inscrição prévia)

➡ Mais informações: site oficial do evento

A dupla gaúcha Kleiton & Kledir celebra mais de 40 anos de carreira com o espetáculo intimista "Histórias e Canções". Em formato acústico, os irmãos apresentam grandes sucessos que atravessam gerações, como “Deu Pra Ti”, “Vira Virou” e “Paixão”, além de compartilharem com o público histórias divertidas e lembranças dos bastidores.

📅 Quando: 13 e 14 de novembro de 2026, às 20h

📍 Onde: Teatro Margarida Schivasappa, Belém

💲 Quanto: Ingressos disponíveis no Sympla

➡ Mais informações: pelo WhatsApp (91) 98510-5190 ou no Sympla

O Complexo Porto Futuro recebe um fim de semana dedicado à música instrumental de artistas paraenses. No sábado (14), o projeto "Porto Instrumental" traz apresentações do SaxoBeat e do Grupo Gema. Já no domingo (15), a música continua com o "Baco Sessions", que reúne sets do DJ Mateus Estrela, Jenelle (Piano & Voz), o grupo Jambuti e uma apresentação de encerramento da Amazônia Jazz Band, que convida Dayse Addario.

📅 Quando: 14 e 15 de novembro (sábado e domingo), a partir das 17h30

📍 Onde: Orla do Complexo Porto Futuro – Belém

O cantor Edu Farias grava seu primeiro projeto audiovisual no Pará, intitulado “No Barzin”. Com a proposta de transportar para o palco a atmosfera dos tradicionais barzinhos, o repertório celebra grandes sucessos do sertanejo tradicional e inclui três músicas autorais. A noite contará com a participação dos convidados Papo em Off, Thiago Costa e Rebeca Lindsay.

📅 Quando: Terça-feira (10), a partir das 19h

Fim de partida, com Marco Nanini — Foto: Divulgação / Fernando Young

O clássico de Samuel Beckett ganha nova montagem dirigida por Rodrigo Portella, com Marco Nanini, Guilherme Weber, Helena Ignez e Ary França no elenco. A tragicomédia ácida e melancólica retrata um cenário pós-apocalíptico onde os personagens Hamm e Clov vivem uma trágica dependência física e emocional. Presos em um espaço claustrofóbico, eles enfrentam uma realidade desprovida de sentido, marcada por repetições e jogos de poder.

📅 Quando: até 15 de novembro de 2026. Quartas a sábados, às 19h; domingos, às 17h

📍 Onde: CAIXA Cultural Belém — Avenida Marechal Hermes, s/n, Armazém 6A, Reduto (Porto Futuro II), Belém

💲 Quanto: R$ 30 (inteira), R$ 15 (meia-entrada) e R$ 15 (clientes CAIXA)

➡ Mais informações: Classificação indicativa de 16 anos. Duração de 90 minutos. O espetáculo conta com sessões com acessibilidade

A Escola de Arte Catarse realiza a sua terceira e última mostra de 2026 reunindo dez turmas em quatro espetáculos que integram teatro, dança, ballet, k-pop e palhaçaria. Com o tema “Clássicos”, a programação marca o encerramento dos módulos da escola e apresenta releituras de obras consagradas, como "O Pequeno Príncipe", "Família Addams" e "Dom Casmurro" ("Capitu"), além da montagem cômica "Então, é Natal?".

📅 Quando: 13 e 14 de novembro de 2026 (sexta e sábado), com sessões às 18h30 e 19h40

➡ Mais informações: Ingressos disponíveis diretamente nos canais de comunicação da Escola de Arte Catarse

O espetáculo "Venha Ver a Lona" é o resultado de um curso de formação em técnicas circenses voltado a jovens da região metropolitana de Belém. A apresentação reúne números de malabares, acrobacias, palhaçaria, equilíbrio e trapézio, preparados com dedicação por professores e alunos do projeto.

📍 Onde: Salão Paroquial da Igreja Matriz de Nossa Senhora do Carmo - Avenida Joaquim Pereira Queirós, Centro - Benevides

19ª Mostra Coreográfica e Espetáculo MIRAÇÃO

A Escola de Aplicação da Universidade Federal do Pará (UFPA), por meio do Projeto Itinerâncias Ginásticas, promove a 19ª Mostra Coreográfica e o espetáculo MIRAÇÃO. A programação é dividida em dois atos: o primeiro apresenta trabalhos recentes de escolas, companhias e grupos de dança de Belém; o segundo celebra a cultura amazônica integrando dança, ginástica, brincadeira, riso e rito em uma montagem de cores, luzes e movimentos.

💲 Quanto: R$ 40 (necessário realizar inscrição)

➡ Mais informações: Inscrições abertas até 17 de novembro pela plataforma Even

articles.title: Crime organizado domina 35% do território de Belford Roxo e São João de Meriti, aponta ISP | G1
articles.standfirst: Municípios da Baixada lideram ranking proporcional de levantamento do Instituto de Segurança Pública. Em extensão, a capital tem a maior área sob controle de traficantes e milicianos, seguida por São Gonçalo e Duque de Caxias.
articles.summary: Municípios da Baixada lideram ranking proporcional de levantamento do Instituto de Segurança Pública. Em extensão, a capital tem a maior área sob controle de traficantes e milicianos, seguida por São Gonçalo e Duque de Caxias.
articles.body:
Mais de um terço do território de Belford Roxo e de São João de Meriti, na Baixada Fluminense, está sob domínio de grupos criminosos. Segundo levantamento do Instituto de Segurança Pública (ISP), feito em parceria com as polícias Civil e Militar, os dois municípios têm a maior proporção de área controlada pelo crime no estado do Rio de Janeiro, com 35% cada.

O estudo leva em conta dados coletados em 2025. Em números absolutos, a capital fluminense concentra a maior área sob controle de traficantes e milicianos, com 115 km² . Na sequência estão São Gonçalo, com 65 km², e Duque de Caxias, com 36 km². Os três municípios ficam na Região Metropolitana.

Mapa do ISP mostra o controle dos territórios do RJ por organizações criminosas — Foto: Arte/g1

Nas áreas dominadas, as restrições impostas pelos criminosos afetam até quem pode chegar à casa de um morador. Em depoimento à TV Globo, um morador contou que homens armados ficam nas esquinas dia e noite e que quem entra por um caminho diferente do determinado pelo grupo corre o risco de ser alvo de tiros.

“É uma barricada em cima da outra. A gente é obrigado a passar pelos bandidos, que ficam 24 horas nas esquinas”, disse o morador.

Domínio chega a municípios com menos de 15 mil habitantes

O mapa também identificou áreas dominadas em municípios com menos de 15 mil habitantes. É o caso de Comendador Levy Gasparian , na divisa com Minas Gerais, que tinha 8.741 moradores no Censo de 2022.

Trajano de Moraes , com 10.302 habitantes, Duas Barras , com 10.980, Aperibé , com 11.034, e Cardoso Moreira , com 12.958, também aparecem no levantamento.

A socióloga Roberta Fernandes, do Centro de Estudos de Criminalidade e Segurança Pública da Universidade Federal de Minas Gerais (Crisp-UFMG), afirma que a expansão territorial reflete a capacidade dessas organizações de acumular recursos, montar redes de proteção e explorar outras atividades econômicas além do tráfico de drogas.

Segundo a pesquisadora, o controle também se manifesta em regras impostas aos moradores e comerciantes, como toques de recolher e restrições sobre quem pode vender e quais produtos podem ser comercializados.

Levantamento aponta 21 municípios sem áreas dominadas

Em 21 dos 92 municípios fluminenses, o ISP não identificou áreas sob controle de grupos criminosos em 2025. Veja a lista em ordem alfabética.

articles.title: Amazônia das Palavras: Oficina une música e literatura em Rondônia | G1
articles.standfirst: Atividade do Amazônia das Palavras, conduzida pelo percussionista Bira Lourenço, estimulou estudantes de Nova Mamoré a transformar sonoridades do dia a dia em inspiração para a criação literária.
articles.summary: O projeto Amazônia das Palavras promoveu em Nova Mamoré uma oficina com Bira Lourenço que ensina estudantes a usar sons do cotidiano como base para a criação literária.
articles.body:
O barulho da água fervendo, uma colher batendo na panela ou os passos durante uma caminhada podem guardar lembranças e até inspirar histórias. Sons aparentemente comuns, mas carregados de significados, foram o ponto de partida para uma experiência literária com estudantes da Escola Estadual de Ensino Fundamental e Médio Casimiro de Abreu, em Nova Mamoré , no interior de Rondônia. Nesta quarta-feira (11), o projeto Amazônia das Palavras – Quarta Edição promoveu no município a oficina Música e Literatura, conduzida pelo músico e percussionista Bira Lourenço.

A proposta foi mostrar que a criação literária não começa necessariamente com as palavras. Antes de escrever, os estudantes foram convidados a exercitar a escuta, identificar sonoridades presentes no cotidiano e perceber como elas podem despertar memórias e alimentar a imaginação.

“Uma das minhas lições é despertar as pessoas para uma coisa muito simples e, por vezes, subestimada: as sonoridades ao nosso redor. As pessoas usam cada vez mais fones de ouvido e deixam de perceber esses sons. Mas isso é música. São sons que despertam memórias”, explicou Bira.

Durante a oficina, o músico apresentou situações em que ruídos cotidianos se transformam em referências afetivas. O barulho de uma colher na panela pode lembrar a comida preparada por uma avó, enquanto a água fervendo pode trazer à memória um café compartilhado em família. A partir dessas associações, os participantes foram estimulados a reconhecer suas próprias referências e compreender como elas podem ganhar forma em poemas, contos e outras narrativas.

A relação entre música e literatura também passa pela maneira como cada pessoa interpreta uma história. Para Bira, a leitura permite que o público construa uma experiência particular, associando palavras e narrativas aos sons que fazem parte de sua própria trajetória.

“Todo mundo tem um repertório de sons e memórias. A partir do momento em que você lê um poema ou um conto, pode construir a sua própria trilha sonora, a sua dramaturgia sonora pessoal, a partir dessas lembranças. Gosto de trabalhar isso: que, ao ler um texto ou contar uma história, venham junto também esses sons”, afirmou.

Uma oficina que continua depois da sala de aula

Amazônia das Palavras nas escolas de Rondônia — Foto: Divulgação/Rede Amazônica

O exercício proposto por Bira não termina quando os estudantes deixam a escola. A intenção é que a experiência se estenda a atividades simples, como lavar a louça, varrer a casa ou caminhar pela rua, despertando a atenção para sons que normalmente passam despercebidos.

“Às vezes, no começo, eles acham que é uma bobagem. Mas, durante o processo, aquilo vai se construindo e ficando mais elaborado. A gente sabe que fica uma fagulha de alguma coisa. A pessoa vai lavar a louça, vai varrer o chão de casa e vai se lembrar: ‘Caramba, aquele maluco falou isso’. É um resultado muito interessante”, contou.

Os efeitos da atividade também foram percebidos pela equipe pedagógica. Durante a entrega de livros à biblioteca, a supervisora da escola relatou que alguns estudantes a procuraram espontaneamente para contar como havia sido a experiência com o músico. A iniciativa despertou a curiosidade dos alunos e prolongou as conversas sobre a oficina mesmo depois do encerramento do encontro.

“Foi muito gratificante perceber a empolgação dos alunos depois da oficina. Alguns vieram espontaneamente conversar comigo, contar o que tinham feito e dividir o que aprenderam com o Bira. Isso mostra que a atividade conseguiu despertar o interesse deles e deixar uma experiência que continua mesmo depois que o oficineiro sai da escola. É esse tipo de vivência que amplia o olhar dos estudantes e mostra que a arte e a literatura também podem fazer parte do dia a dia deles”, destacou a supervisora.

Amazônia das Palavras — Foto: Divulgação/Rede Amazônica

Além das atividades formativas, a passagem do projeto por Nova Mamoré incluiu a doação de livros à biblioteca da escola e a entrega do certificado Escola Amiga da Leitura, que busca incentivar a continuidade das ações de promoção da leitura no ambiente escolar.

A programação também reuniu atividades culturais abertas à comunidade, com homenagem à escritora Maria Firmina dos Reis, exibição do documentário Amazônia das Palavras – Terceira Edição e apresentação do espetáculo circense Palhaço Soul, conduzido pelo artista Lincoln Rolim, conhecido como Palhaço Carlão.

Localizado na região oeste de Rondônia, Nova Mamoré tem sua história relacionada ao ciclo da borracha e à Estrada de Ferro Madeira-Mamoré. Ao levar oficinas literárias e apresentações culturais ao município, o Amazônia das Palavras aproxima estudantes e moradores de diferentes manifestações artísticas e amplia as possibilidades de acesso à produção cultural.

A segunda etapa do projeto segue para Guajará-Mirim, onde a programação será realizada nesta sexta-feira (13), na Escola Estadual de Ensino Médio em Tempo Integral Símon Bolívar. Todas as atividades são gratuitas.

Amazônia das Palavras em Rond — Foto: Divulgação/Rede Amazônica

O Amazônia das Palavras – Quarta Edição é realizado com recursos da Lei Rouanet, Lei Federal de Incentivo à Cultura, com apoio da Cigás, promoção da Fundação Rede Amazônica e realização da Associação Mapinguari, Ministério da Cultura e Governo do Brasil. A iniciativa promove o acesso à literatura, à formação cultural e à valorização das diferentes expressões artísticas e identidades da Amazônia.

articles.title: Nove dias após votação, democrata vence disputa pelo governo do Kansas | G1
articles.standfirst: Cindy Holscher derrotou o candidato republicano Ty Masterson e manterá governo democrata em estado dominado pelos republicanos. Vitória foi projetada nesta quinta-feira (12).
articles.summary: Cindy Holscher derrotou o candidato republicano Ty Masterson e manterá governo democrata em estado dominado pelos republicanos. Vitória foi projetada nesta quinta-feira (12).
articles.body:
Democrata Cindy Holscher venceu eleição para o governo do Kansas, nos EUA — Foto: Nathan Howard/REUTERS

A democrata Cindy Holscher foi declarada vencedora da eleição para o governo do Kansas, nos Estados Unidos , nove dias depois da votação. A Associated Press confirmou o resultado nesta quinta-feira (12). A eleição foi realizada em 3 de novembro.

Holscher derrotou o republicano Ty Masterson, presidente do Senado estadual, e garantiu a permanência dos democratas no comando do governo do Kansas.

Ela vai substituir a atual governadora, Laura Kelly, também democrata, que não podia disputar um novo mandato por causa do limite de reeleições.

Holscher, que é senadora estadual, vai substituir a governadora Laura Kelly, também democrata, que não podia disputar um novo mandato. Durante a campanha, ela prometeu suspender a construção de novos centros de dados voltados à inteligência artificial.

O resultado no governo estadual chama atenção porque o Kansas é tradicionalmente republicano. Nas últimas seis décadas, sempre que um governador deixou o cargo por aposentadoria ou por limite de mandato, o candidato do partido adversário venceu a eleição seguinte.

Durante a campanha, Holscher prometeu suspender a construção de novos centros de dados voltados à inteligência artificial. Ela afirmou que os moradores querem limitar o consumo de energia e água dessas instalações e garantir que os projetos gerem empregos na região.

A democrata também enfrentou uma campanha com forte investimento financeiro dos republicanos. Segundo a empresa de monitoramento de publicidade AdImpact, a Associação dos Governadores Republicanos destinou US$ 19 milhões a anúncios na televisão e em plataformas digitais.

No total, os republicanos gastaram mais de três vezes o valor investido pelos democratas.

articles.title: Linha 8 da ViaMobilidade acumula quase 40 falhas em 1 ano; Tarcísio não descarta romper contrato com concessionária | G1
articles.standfirst: Passageiros precisaram deixar trem parado entre Carapicuíba e General Miguel Costa após pane antes das 7h; Artesp rejeitou, em outubro, proposta de abertura de processo de pré-caducidade, mas diz que reúne dados para embasar possível rompimento da concessão.
articles.summary: Passageiros precisaram deixar trem parado entre Carapicuíba e General Miguel Costa após pane antes das 7h; Artesp rejeitou, em outubro, proposta de abertura de processo de pré-caducidade, mas diz que reúne dados para embasar possível rompimento da concessão.
articles.body:
A Linha 8-Diamante, operada pela ViaMobilidade , registrou nesta quinta-feira (12) a 39ª falha do ano. O problema aconteceu antes das 7h, entre as estações Carapicuíba e General Miguel Costa, na Grande São Paulo , e afetou a circulação de toda a linha. Passageiros ficaram presos dentro de um trem por cerca de 1 hora e 15 minutos e precisaram abrir as janelas e sair da composição.

A nova ocorrência provocou revolta entre os usuários e levou o governador de São Paulo, Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos), a voltar a falar sobre a possibilidade de extinguir o contrato com a concessionária.

"Eu tenho uma revolta, uma indignação. São trens que, rotineiramente, falham. A gente não pode admitir isso", afirmou o governador.

Tarcísio disse que o governo pediu uma reunião com o conselho da empresa e que cobra medidas firmes para melhorar o serviço. Segundo ele, o rompimento do contrato pode ser uma consequência das falhas.

"E a gente pode, inclusive, culminar lá na frente com a extinção do contrato", declarou.

Apesar da cobrança do governador, no mês passado a Agência Reguladora de Serviços Públicos Delegados de Transporte do Estado de São Paulo (Artesp), responsável pela fiscalização da concessão, rejeitou uma proposta de abertura de um processo de pré-caducidade do contrato. A agência, no entanto, afirmou que continua reunindo informações para embasar uma eventual medida.

Passageiros precisaram sair de trem parado

A falha desta quinta-feira foi provocada pela falta de tração no trem, segundo a ViaMobilidade. A concessionária informou que está investigando a causa do problema com o fabricante da composição e equipes de engenharia.

Passageiros relataram momentos de tensão dentro do trem, que ficou parado no meio do trajeto. Segundo um dos usuários, as pessoas tiveram que forçar a abertura das janelas para conseguir deixar a composição.

"Nós ficamos uma hora e quinze minutos dentro do trem. A gente teve que abrir a janela, forçar para baixo, empurrar. Machuquei até o dedo, e aí a gente foi descer", contou.

O passageiro também relatou que havia pessoas passando mal por causa do calor e da falta de ar-condicionado, além de uma mulher grávida entre os usuários.

"Esse rapaz foi um anjo na vida de muita gente que estava lá. Pessoas passando mal dentro do trem. Ar desligado, tinha grávida dentro do trem", disse.

Em nota, a ViaMobilidade afirmou que está apurando a principal causa da ocorrência e destacou que tem mais de 2.500 colaboradores trabalhando diariamente para garantir a operação.

A empresa também disse que o episódio vai gerar aprendizados para melhorar o serviço.

Linha 8-Diamante tem 39ª falha no ano, e governo volta a falar em romper contrato com ViaMobilidade — Foto: Reprodução/TV Globo

Satisfação dos passageiros está abaixo do mínimo exigido

A concessão das linhas 8-Diamante e 9-Esmeralda começou há cinco anos. Desde então, a ViaMobilidade afirma ter investido R$ 5 bilhões em melhorias na infraestrutura e na operação.

Apesar dos investimentos anunciados, os indicadores de qualidade do serviço continuam abaixo do esperado.

Na pesquisa de satisfação mais recente, realizada em abril deste ano, os índices de rapidez, conforto, confiabilidade e segurança operacional caíram em relação ao mesmo período do ano passado.

O índice geral de satisfação dos passageiros ficou em 57 pontos. O mínimo exigido pelo governo no contrato de concessão é de 70 pontos.

Técnicos da Artesp apontaram descarrilamentos e acidentes

A possibilidade de rompimento do contrato foi discutida recentemente dentro da própria Artesp.

No dia 20 de outubro, técnicos da área de transporte sobre trilhos da agência sugeriram a abertura de um processo de pré-caducidade da concessão. O documento levou em consideração registros de oito descarrilamentos e quase 100 acidentes envolvendo passageiros nas linhas operadas pela ViaMobilidade neste ano.

A proposta, porém, foi rejeitada pela direção da agência, que pediu mais argumentos para considerar a possibilidade de rompimento do contrato.

A caducidade é o mecanismo jurídico que permite ao poder público extinguir uma concessão por descumprimento de obrigações contratuais. A medida é considerada extrema e exige o cumprimento de etapas e procedimentos legais.

A Artesp afirmou que o assunto continua em análise e que está reunindo dados para embasar um eventual processo.

"A caducidade da concessão é algo que está no nosso radar. A Artesp já tem experiência em fazer isso, a gente já fez isso outras vezes e a gente sabe que esse é um instrumento que está à disposição e que a gente sabe usar e vai usar sempre que for necessário", afirmou um representante da agência.

Histórico de problemas e investigação do Ministério Público

Um dos descarrilamentos citados pelos técnicos da Artesp aconteceu em abril deste ano. Na ocasião, a ViaMobilidade levou sete horas para normalizar a operação.

Na época, a cúpula da concessionária se reuniu com o governador Tarcísio de Freitas. Dias depois, um funcionário da empresa morreu após sofrer uma descarga elétrica durante um serviço de manutenção. Em junho, o então diretor das linhas 8 e 9 foi demitido.

O Ministério Público de São Paulo também investiga os problemas na operação da concessionária. Segundo o promotor responsável pelo caso, o órgão já está no segundo inquérito sobre as falhas nas linhas.

No primeiro procedimento, a empresa teve que se comprometer a realizar uma série de investimentos que não estavam previstos inicialmente no contrato, como forma de indenização aos passageiros.

O segundo inquérito foi aberto após novos problemas na operação. O Ministério Público pretende chamar a Artesp e a ViaMobilidade para prestar esclarecimentos e apresentar informações sobre as medidas adotadas.

O promotor também apontou uma possível omissão da Artesp na fiscalização das linhas 8 e 9 e quer saber quais providências a concessionária está tomando para evitar novas ocorrências.

Governo discute mudanças nas regras de concessões

Em novembro, o governo estadual abriu uma consulta pública para discutir novas regras para contratos de concessão. A proposta prevê a possibilidade de renegociar acordos que já estão em andamento, inclusive com a substituição da empresa responsável pelo serviço.

A Secretaria de Parcerias e Investimentos afirmou que o procedimento não é direcionado a nenhuma concessionária específica. Segundo a pasta, o objetivo é estabelecer regras transparentes para aperfeiçoar contratos de longo prazo com a iniciativa privada.

Enquanto as investigações e discussões sobre o contrato continuam, os passageiros das linhas 8 e 9 seguem convivendo com falhas na operação, mesmo após cinco anos de concessão e os investimentos anunciados pela empresa.

articles.title: Incêndio de grandes proporções atinge borracharia na BR-135, em São Luís | G1
articles.standfirst: Corpo de Bombeiros foi acionado por volta das 15h30 e trabalha para impedir que as chamas atinjam residências e estabelecimentos próximos. Não há informações sobre feridos.
articles.summary: Corpo de Bombeiros foi acionado por volta das 15h30 e trabalha para impedir que as chamas atinjam residências e estabelecimentos próximos. Não há informações sobre feridos.
articles.body:
Um incêndio de grandes proporções atingiu uma borracharia localizada no km 6 da BR-135, na entrada da Vila Maranhão, em São Luís , na tarde desta quinta-feira (12). Segundo o Corpo de Bombeiros Militar do Maranhão (CBMMA), a corporação foi acionada por volta das 15h30 e trabalha para impedir que as chamas atinjam imóveis próximos.

De acordo com os bombeiros, o estabelecimento possui grande quantidade de materiais combustíveis, como borracha e óleo, o que dificulta o combate ao incêndio.

Quatro viaturas de combate a incêndio foram mobilizadas para a ocorrência, além de uma viatura de apoio. As equipes atuam para evitar que o fogo se espalhe para residências e outros estabelecimentos da região.

Ainda segundo o Corpo de Bombeiros, o incêndio ainda não havia sido controlado até a última atualização. A prioridade das equipes é proteger os imóveis próximos ao local.

Até o momento, não há informações sobre feridos. A causa do incêndio ainda não foi informada.

articles.title: Super El Niño declared as forecasters warn of major shifts in weather during winter season
articles.summary: The Climate Prediction Center (CPC) announced Thursday that the 2026 El Niño has officially reached Super El Niño status, also known as a Very Strong El Niño...
articles.body:
NOAA announced that the 2026 El Niño has reached Super El Niño status.

Water temperatures in the Niño 3.4 region of the equatorial Pacific have climbed to 2.0°C above average for three consecutive months.

A Super El Niño will have a major impact on the 2026–2027 winter, causing more storms in the southern tier of the U.S. and above-average temperatures in the northern tier.

NOAA's Climate Prediction Center (CPC) announced Thursday that the 2026 El Niño has officially reached Super El Niño status, also known as a Very Strong El Niño.

Water temperatures in the Niño 3.4 region of the equatorial Pacific, where forecasters monitor the strength of El Niño, have climbed to 2.0°C above average, meeting the threshold for the designation.

To determine the strength of the climate pattern, forecasters use a three-month average of ocean temperatures rather than daily readings. This approach helps account for short-term fluctuations and provides a more consistent picture of changing ocean conditions.

The latest evaluation found that the three-month period from August through October reached the 2°C threshold. An earlier assessment covering July through September did not record temperatures high enough to qualify as a Super El Niño.

El Niño has been in effect since late spring, gradually strengthening throughout the summer and into the fall.

Forecasters had anticipated for months that the climate pattern would reach Super status by late fall, with conditions potentially lasting through spring 2027. By then, La Niña conditions are forecast to take over.

Even before officially reaching Super status, El Niño has already shown the potential to influence weather patterns around the world, particularly during hurricane season in the Atlantic and Pacific basins.

The last Super El Niño occurred during 2015–2016, making the current event particularly significant.

One of the hallmarks of a Super El Niño pattern is an extended, highly active Pacific jet stream. This acts as a storm conveyor belt, steering repeated systems and moisture across the southern tier of the country.

According to NOAA's Winter Outlook for the 2026–27 season, increased storm activity is expected from Southern California across the southern U.S. and into Florida.

California , the Southwest , Texas , the Gulf Coast, the Southeast and parts of the Mid-Atlantic could experience more frequent storms and above-average precipitation.

Florida could be particularly vulnerable to periods of heavy rainfall and even severe weather.

Signs of this active pattern were already evident last week, when multiple rounds of storms brought flooding to parts of the Sunshine State.

Along the Pacific Coast, repeated atmospheric river events could bring periods of heavy rain and mountain snow.

Super El Niño can also influence winter temperatures across the country, creating a noticeable divide between the northern and southern U.S.

This pattern is largely driven by the position of the jet stream, which typically shifts farther south during El Niño winters. The resulting circulation can allow milder Pacific air to spread across the northern states while directing stormier conditions into the South.

Persistent high pressure and Pacific-influenced air across the Pacific Northwest , Northern Plains, Upper Midwest and Great Lakes could contribute to above-average winter temperatures. Much of Canada is also expected to experience a warmer-than-average winter.

Meanwhile, frequent precipitation, extensive cloud cover and active storm tracks across the southern U.S. could keep daytime temperatures below average in parts of the Southwest , Southern Plains and Gulf Coast.

Snowfall potential can also shift significantly during a Super El Niño winter.

Because snowstorms depend on the overlap of abundant moisture and sufficiently cold temperatures, changes in the jet stream can create contrasting outcomes across some of the country's major winter weather regions.

With the active Pacific jet stream directing moisture toward California and the Southwest, mountain elevations in the Sierra Nevada and Southern Rockies could see significant snowfall.

Farther east, an energized southern storm track could increase the potential for heavy precipitation and coastal nor'easters from the Southern Plains to the Mid-Atlantic .

If cold air masses push far enough south and interact with this active corridor of moisture, the setup could support high-impact winter storms.

However, with the northern branch of the jet stream typically displaced farther north during El Niño, traditionally cold and snowy regions could see below-average seasonal snowfall. This includes parts of the Northern Rockies, Midwest and Northeast .

That doesn't mean winter storms are off the table. Individual Arctic air outbreaks can still bring bitterly cold temperatures and significant snowfall, even in an overall warmer-than-average winter.

Nor'easters can become more frequent during El Niño winters because the large-scale weather pattern often favors storm development across the southern U.S. before systems move toward the East Coast.

Unusually warm waters in the tropical Pacific influence the jet stream, often strengthening the subtropical jet across the southern U.S. This can create a more active storm track from the Gulf Coast and Southeast toward the Atlantic Seaboard.

Rather than tracking north through Canada , more weather disturbances can move east across the southern states before turning northeast along the coast, creating favorable conditions for nor'easter development.

These storms strengthen by drawing energy from sharp contrasts between warm and cold air.

During El Niño winters, storms moving northward can pull warm, moisture-rich air from the South into contact with colder air over the Northeast.

This temperature contrast can help storms rapidly intensify, potentially producing powerful winds, heavy precipitation, coastal flooding and, when temperatures are cold enough, significant snowfall.

However, even though nor'easters will be more prevalent during El Niño, it does not guarantee there will bring more impacts in the form of rain, snow and wind.

articles.title: Indian nationals among 14 killed in deadly multi-vehicle crash in UAE's Fujairah
articles.summary: A truck crash involving 23 vehicles in the United Arab Emirates' Fujairah emirate killed 14 people and injured 30 others after the driver lost control of
articles.body: A truck crash involving 23 vehicles in the United Arab Emirates' Fujairah emirate killed 14 people and injured 30 others after the driver lost control of the vehicle, triggering a fire that spread to several other vehicles, police said on Thursday.The Indian Consulate in the UAE confirmed that Indian nationals were among those killed, adding that it had reached out to the "bereaved families" and was coordinating with local authorities to provide assistance and support.The accident occurred shortly before midnight on Sheikh Khalifa bin Zayed Road, near the entrance to Fujairah, when the truck collided with another vehicle before overturning and hitting several vehicles that had stopped due to "slow-moving traffic", Fujairah Police said.The collision involved 23 vehicles, including five trucks. The impact caused the truck to catch fire, with the blaze spreading to several other vehicles and resulting in a heavy loss of life, the UAE Interior Ministry said in a statement.Thirty people were injured and taken to hospital. Fifteen of them have since been discharged after receiving treatment, while the remaining 15 continue to receive medical care, police said.The deceased included Emirati nationals, while the injured were from the UAE, Oman, India, Brazil, Pakistan, Jordan and Egypt. Authorities are using DNA tests to identify some of the victims.Emergency services, including police, ambulance crews and civil defence teams, rushed to the scene to extinguish the fire, evacuate the injured and secure the area. Specialist teams remain at the site, police said.The interior ministry and Fujairah Police expressed their condolences to the families of the deceased and wished those injured a speedy recovery.You use AI every day. articles.title: Rolls-Royce gas leak prompts emergency response
articles.summary: Derbyshire Fire and Rescue Service said it was called to the site in Raynesway on Thursday afternoon.
articles.body:
Emergency services have responded to a gas leak at a Rolls-Royce factory in Derby.

Derbyshire Fire and Rescue Service said it was called to the site in Raynesway at about 15:40 GMT on Thursday.

It said police, fire crews and ambulances responded to a "small chemical and gas leak", adding this was "not a nuclear incident", and that all employees were accounted for.

A 300m (985ft) cordon was put in place and locals were asked to remain indoors with windows and doors shut, however the guidance was lifted shortly before 22:00.

A BBC reporter at the scene was advised by police to stay in her car for her safety, and an alarm was heard coming from the building.

A number of roads were closed around the factory, including Royal Scot Way, Pride Park Way, from Derby Audi to the London Road roundabout, Harrow Street, and London Road, from the junction of Harrow Steet to Meadow Lane. They have all reopened, the fire service said.

In a statement, a fire service spokesperson added: "Emergency services and Rolls-Royce would like to thank local residents and businesses for their co-operation while the incident was resolved safely and as quickly as possible.

"The incident has now been handed over to Rolls-Royce."

The Raynesway Rolls-Royce site designs, manufactures, and supports nuclear reactors and nuclear steam-raising plants that power every submarine in the UK Royal Navy.

It is the subject of plans to create more factory space to meet the growth in demand from the Royal Navy and as a result of the recent AUKUS announcement.

In March 2023, it was confirmed that Rolls-Royce Submarines would provide all the nuclear reactor plants that will power new attack submarines as part of the tri-lateral agreement between Australia, the UK and US.

This increase in demand will see new manufacturing and office facilities being built on recently acquired land surrounding the existing Raynesway site.

It will also create 1,170 skilled roles within Rolls-Royce across a range of disciplines, including manufacturing and engineering.

articles.title: UK mosque rebukes comission’s ‘warning’ following Palestine comments
articles.summary: The Lewisham Islamic Centre accused the charity watchdog of imposing disproportionate expectations on Muslim charities.
articles.body:
The Lewisham Islamic Centre (LIC) in London has rejected a warning issued by the UK’s independent Charity Commission, which reprimanded the mosque for comments on Palestinian suffering made by an imam during October 2023 sermons.

“The matters raised by the Commission represent a troubling attempt to scrutinise, restrict and penalise legitimate religious worship” and “the expression of solidarity with the Palestinian people,” the mosque said in an official statement issued Wednesday.

The statement comes after the charity watchdog accused the religious centre of including “content that was inflammatory, divisive and not in the charity’s best interests” during two separate sermons, as they issued an official warning urging the centre to “improve its handling of speakers and events hosted at the charity’s premises” on October 20.

The commission warned that if the mosque fails to “remedy the misconduct”, it may be subjected to further action.

The mosque also accused the commission of imposing disproportionate expectations on Muslim charities after the warning, describing them as “unnecessarily burdensome”. The religious centre explained that a sermon, or khutbah, is an integral part of Islamic worship and often speaks to the issues affecting the wellbeing of congregations and their communities. The LIC worried that the warning suggested the commission was “entitled to dictate which subjects Imams may address in their khutbahs”.

LIC added that they are currently seeking legal advice as to the best way to move forward following the warning.

CAGE International, a London-based human rights organisation, supported the mosque, and claimed the Charity Commission showed lenience when it came to pro-Israel charities.

“The Commission’s position treats the word ‘Zionist’ as inflammatory in itself,” CAGE said on Thursday. “This merges opposition to a political ideology with hatred of a people, and places Muslim religious expression under suspicion by default.”

“The Commission has told a mosque that naming who is responsible for Palestinian suffering falls outside acceptable religious practice,” a spokesperson for CAGE said. “This is the same regulator asking for the power to remove trustees for their views,” they added, referring to a recent government consultation to expand the Charity Commission’s powers.

articles.title: Father paid for a country home and its renovations but put it in one daughter’s name; the High Court rejects half-sister’s claim that it was held in trust for the family
articles.summary: Two half-siblings disputed the beneficial ownership of Moonhills, a country home in Beaulieu, Hampshire, after their father paid for its purchase and
articles.body: Two half-siblings disputed the beneficial ownership of Moonhills, a country home in Beaulieu, Hampshire, after their father paid for its purchase and registered it in one daughter’s name. Lindsay Bisiker claimed that Judith held the property on trust for their father or the family. Judith denied the claim and maintained that she owned the house outright. According to the England and Wales High Court (Chancery Division) decisions, the court found that Moonhills had been purchased for Judith to own absolutely and declared her its sole beneficial owner. The claim arose after Lindsay was excluded from the property on 28 April 2023.Father bought a Hampshire property in daughter’s name in 1984Moonhills was purchased in 1984. Jim Bisiker, Lindsay and Judith’s father, paid the purchase price and associated costs. The property is in Moonhills Lane, Beaulieu, Hampshire, and is registered at HM Land Registry in Judith’s name. Jim also paid for renovations, running costs and the construction of an annexe, new stables and a tennis court.Judith lived at Moonhills from 1984 to 1995. Jim and his wife Brenda used it as a holiday home, particularly during the summer, while other family members visited from time to time. Lindsay later became the family member who used the house most regularly and maintained a long-standing connection with it. The property was registered there under title number HP125859.Why did Lindsay challenge Judith’s ownership of MoonhillsLindsay brought the claim against Judith and her other siblings and parents in September 2024. She argued that Judith held Moonhills on trust for Jim, Brenda and the children, or alternatively for the children. She also advanced a claim that the property was held on a resulting trust for Jim. Lindsay sought a declaration about the alleged trust and an order allowing her to return to Moonhills.She said she had been evicted on 28 April 2023 and sought damages or equitable compensation. Judith disputed the claim. The court identified the central question as whether Moonhills had been purchased for Judith to hold on trust or to hold absolutely.Court reveals father's intentions behind the 1984 property purchaseThe judge examined the circumstances of the 1984 purchase, the family’s use of Moonhills and later family documents. The judgment recorded that Jim wanted a holiday home in England and also wanted to provide Judith with a home. He was concerned about his tax position and did not want to own property in the United Kingdom, either legally or beneficially.The court found that Jim trusted Judith and had decided not to make a declaration of trust. Later emails and statements were considered, including statements Jim signed in May 2023. The judge found that Jim’s 25 May 2023 statement was contradictory and not sufficiently precise to amount to a declaration of trust in favour of the children.High Court declares Judith the sole beneficial ownerAccording to the High Court, Jim’s intentions and motivations in 1984 were complex, but the evidence showed that he wanted to buy a home for Judith that could also be used by the family. The judge found that Jim did not want to be the legal or beneficial owner of Moonhills and that his dealings with tax advisers from 2004 onwards consistently treated the property as Judith’s. It concluded that Moonhills had been purchased for Judith to hold absolutely. Judith was therefore entitled to a declaration that she was its sole beneficial owner.Disclaimer: This article is based on the judgment delivered by the England and Wales High Court (Chancery Division). articles.title: Duran Duran's Roger Taylor quits Birmingham band over tinnitus
articles.summary: Roger Taylor says his condition has been getting steadily worse, and he must now "listen to my body and my doctors".
articles.body:
Duran Duran drummer Roger Taylor said he will leave the band due to his worsening tinnitus.

Taylor has been the chart-topping group's drummer since they formed in Birmingham in 1978, which he described as "the joy of my life", but said he had "reached the point where I must now listen to my body and my doctors".

The 66-year-old said his condition has been getting steadily worse, leading to him making one of his hardest decisions to quit the band.

The group, made up of Simon Le Bon, keyboardist Nick Rhodes and guitarist John Taylor, said his decision came after "careful consideration and medical advice", which said that "protecting his hearing and long-term health must now come first".

Taylor, who left the band in 1985 before returning in 2001, said: "Playing drums in this band has been the joy of my life, and I'll never be able to properly thank the fans for the love they've shown us over the years.

"But the truth is that my tinnitus has been getting steadily worse," he said.

He said deciding on the timing had been difficult but he was pleased to be "going out on a real high".

"We've just returned from a hugely successful UK and European tour, which followed our second headline show at BST Hyde Park, our induction into the Rock & Roll Hall Of Fame, and a return to the studio with Nile Rodgers.

"I couldn't have asked for a better final chapter, with so many special moments that I'll treasure forever.

"I move on with enormous pride, and with nothing but love for Simon, Nick and John," he said.

Taylor's band members added that he had helped define the sound of the group, performing on 10 hit albums, their two number one singles - Is There Something I Should Know? and The Reflex - and the band's 1985 James Bond theme A View To A Kill.

"His drumming helped define the sound of Duran Duran from the very beginning and having him back with us since 2001 has been incredibly important to us all.

"We completely support his decision and wish him health and happiness.

"He will always be part of this family, while we continue exploring new and exciting projects with the band."

articles.title: Historic vote nixes 150-year booze ban in once-dry New Jersey town
articles.summary: A New Jersey town has ended its 153-year alcohol ban with 60.4% of voters approving sales, yet residents of the area are divided over the BYOB culture.
articles.body: A suburb of Philadelphia has voted to end its long-standing ban on alcohol sales — reversing restrictions that date back more than 150 years. Voters in Collingswood, New Jersey, approved a ballot measure on Nov. 3 allowing alcohol sales at licensed establishments. The move lifts restrictions that have existed in the town since the 19th century. The ballot question read, "Shall the retail sale of all kinds of alcoholic beverages, for consumption on the licensed premises by the glass or other open receptacle... be permitted in this municipality?" WINE, BEER OR LIQUOR: STUDY FINDS ONE DRINK IS LINKED TO LOWER RISK OF DEATH THAN OTHERS Election data obtained by Fox News Digital from Camden County show that 3,635 residents voted in favor of the measure, while 2,381 people voted against it. The measure passed with roughly 60.4% of the vote, compared with 39.6% opposed, a margin of 1,254 votes. A total of 6,016 votes were cast on the municipal question, with all 12 precincts reporting. The town's alcohol restrictions date back to 1873, when residents voted to ban alcohol sales in the area, then part of Haddon Township, according to a 2019 environmental resource inventory published by the Borough of Collingswood. RED WINE OR WHITE WINE? DOCTOR REVEALS THE HEALTHIER CHOICE, AS WELL AS CAUTIONARY DETAILS In 1935 — two years after Prohibition ended — Collingswood residents voted against a ballot measure that would have allowed retail alcohol sales and the issuance of liquor licenses. A total of 3,859 voted against the measure and just 774 in favor, according to a New Jersey Alcoholic Beverage Control bulletin from that year. Collingswood Deputy Mayor Amy Henderson Riley welcomed the results, calling the vote "historic." "After 91 years, Collingswood is no longer a dry town," Riley said in a social media post, referring to the 1935 ballot measure. "That's historic." CLICK HERE TO SIGN UP FOR OUR LIFESTYLE NEWSLETTER A month before the election, Reddit users in a South Jersey-themed forum debated whether Collingswood should lift its longstanding alcohol ban. "Collingswood is an epicenter of food in South Jersey and deserves a liquor license," one person said. "The alcohol ban is dumb and people are scared of change," another Redditor wrote. CLICK HERE FOR MORE LIFESTYLE NEWS Others were divided over whether allowing alcohol sales would benefit the borough's restaurant scene. "I don't know. I like the whole BYOB vibe," a Redditor said. "I'd rather spend my money on good food." TEST YOURSELF WITH OUR LATEST LIFESTYLE QUIZ "Counterpoint: Collingswood is an epicenter of food in SJ because there are no liquor licenses," another person said. "Restaurants succeed or fail based on the quality of their food and not their ability to finance a license." The vote came as another centuries-old alcohol restriction faces scrutiny, with the U.S. Supreme Court agreeing to review a federal ban on distilling spirits at home. articles.title: What we know about Brooklyn building collapse that killed eight people
articles.summary: Two construction workers and two children were killed when a residential building fell into an adjacent construction site on Wednesday.
articles.body:
Eight people have died and 18 more were injured after a three-storey building collapsed in the Flatbush neighbourhood of Brooklyn, New York.

Witnesses described hearing a loud boom and seeing dust in the air as the building came down and fell into an adjacent construction pit where people were working on Wednesday.

New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani, described a harrowing scene, saying workers "who had only barely survived themselves turned back and dug victims out of the rubble".

The city's fire commissioner, Lillian Bonsignore, said firefighters were on the scene within minutes and called their actions "incredibly heroic".

Speaking on Thursday, she said fire crews "are still in a recovery phase".

Despite the hard rain and falling temperatures at the site, she said, their efforts would continue until every victim was located.

'How does a building just fall?' Neighbours grieve after deadly Brooklyn building collapse

The building at 1321 Flatbush Avenue in Brooklyn was constructed in the 1930s. It contained apartments and a store.

At the construction site next door, plans have been approved for a new building that will include 64 residential units and a grocery store on the bottom floor.

Active work was happening on the site, and it appears part of the building fell into the construction pit, trapping and killing some workers.

It is too early to say what caused the building to collapse at around 16:00 local time (21:00 GMT) on Wednesday, but officials say they are looking into the possibility of filing criminal charges.

The structure was fully occupied by residents, and construction workers were performing excavation work on a neighbouring site at the time, according to CBS News, the BBC's US partner.

It's not clear if the construction had anything to do with the collapse, and the city's buildings department says it is still investigating.

Investigators have said developers have active permits for excavation and foundation work associated with the new building project. The developer has been identified as Robert Fischman.

In a post on X, Brooklyn District Attorney Eric Gonzalez said: "We are working closely with the Department of Buildings and our law enforcement partners to determine whether any criminal conduct contributed to this tragedy."

Mayor Mamdani later emphasised this message in a news conference, saying that every entity involved in the building and the construction site will be investigated, and held accountable.

Eight people - six adults and two children - were killed, authorities said. Two were construction workers.

Mamdani said that six people were pronounced dead at the scene, while another two died in hospital.

Four of the injured are firefighters. One person still in hospital is in a critical condition.

None of the victims have yet been identified by city officials.

Mamdani said they were "our friends and our neighbours. Our parents and our children.

"Young families building their lives in our city, and immigrants from Mexico, Colombia, Ecuador, Trinidad and beyond."

The consul general of Ecuador visited the site and confirmed that two victims are Ecuadorian nationals, the New York Times reported.

Gicela Andrade told newspaper that one victim, Jose Luis Caguana Cosquillo, will be flown back to Ecuador for burial. She identified the other victim as Gabriel Ariolfo Siguencia.

More than 250 firefighters responded to the collapse, working through the night to locate trapped victims.

Reporters at the scene described the chaos, which occurred on a normally busy avenue of Brooklyn.

The head of the NY Department of Buildings, Ahmed Tigani, said in a news conference on Thursday that there were no violations of building codes reported at the building before the collapse.

He said the property developer has ties to at least 100 other sites around the city, which are also now being checked.

Forecasters predict scattered showers throughout Thursday, and then heavy rain across the New York region from 17:00 local time (22:00 GMT).

The CBS meteorologist for New York, Tony Sadiku, warns there is a possibility of severe storms later in the evening, which could hamper search and recovery efforts.

One man told the BBC that he had just delivered an Amazon package to an apartment just a few minutes before the building crumbled.

The man, who didn't want to share his name, described hearing a loud "boom" sound.

He was shocked to see the building he had just been in reduced to rubble, he said. Within a minute or two the fire department was on the scene with several trucks, and they quickly closed the street.

"I live literally right behind the building", Emmanuella Carilus told the New York Times. "It sounded like a big boom and you just heard a bunch of screaming."

The husband of one woman who was filmed being rescued spoke of his relief to CBS News New York.

"She is alive... I'm very happy. I'm very happy. I'm very happy. I thank all of you guys. She's pregnant, six months," he said.

With additional reporting by Nada Tawfik and Madeline Halpert in New York

articles.title: Texas demolished a 6,620-foot bridge that had served as a fish habitat for decades, then moved its material offshore to create a 320-acre artificial reef near South Padre Island
articles.summary: Texas has transformed material from the demolished Queen Isabella Causeway into a new 320-acre artificial reef near South Padre Island.
articles.body: Texas has transformed material from the demolished Queen Isabella Causeway into a new 320-acre artificial reef near South Padre Island. The 6,620-foot bridge once connected Port Isabel and South Padre Island and had already provided habitat for fish and invertebrates before its retirement. Its western section later became a safety and navigation concern, prompting the Texas General Land Office to oversee its removal. Rather than treating the old bridge material as waste, the project repurposed it offshore as a long-term marine habitat. The Texas Parks and Wildlife Department’s Artificial Reef Program handled the reefing plan, material-placement protocol, and creation of the new reef, which was completed in July 2026.How the 6,620-foot Queen Isabella Causeway became a new offshore artificial reefThe Queen Isabella Causeway was built in 1954 and served for two decades as the main route between Port Isabel and South Padre Island. According to the Texas General Land Office (GLO), the 6,620-foot bridge also unintentionally functioned as artificial reef habitat for fish and invertebrates. After the Causeway was retired, part of its eastern end was converted into a fishing pier, while the western end was left neglected and eventually posed risks to public safety and navigation. The GLO took responsibility for the bridge’s engineering, design, demolition and removal, while the Texas Parks and Wildlife Department (TPWD) developed the reefing plan and placement protocol.Why Texas moved the old bridge material offshore instead of leaving it as debrisThe project was designed to give the demolished bridge material another purpose rather than simply discard it. The GLO partnered with the department’s Artificial Reef Program to place the material at a new offshore reef site near South Padre Island. The planned reef covered about 320 acres and was intended to allow the old bridge material to continue providing habitat for marine fish and invertebrate species. TPWD was responsible for identifying the reef area, securing the necessary permits and clearances, developing specifications for the materials, and overseeing the reefing process. The GLO, meanwhile, handled the Causeway’s removal and administered its engineering, design and demolition.What the new 320-acre reef could mean for fish and other marine species in the GulfThe completed Queen Isabella Reef adds another artificial habitat to Texas’ network of offshore reef sites. The department says the project was completed in July 2026, creating a 320-acre reef from material recovered from the former Causeway. The agency says artificial reef structures can provide complex, stable and durable habitat in areas of the Gulf where the seafloor is otherwise largely flat and bare. Nearly 200 marine fish species have been observed on Texas artificial reef structures, while red snapper are regularly seen at TPWD reef sites. The new site therefore extends the marine-habitat role the Causeway had already served before its demolition.You use AI every day. Now get your AI Quotient. Take the AIQ test.

articles.title: A Texas granddaughter was barred from coming within 500 feet of family trust property as relatives fought over control; a November 10 appeals court dissolved the restriction but left the inheritance dispute unresolved
articles.summary: A Texas woman can no longer be kept 500 feet away from her family's trust property after an appeals court overturned restrictions imposed by a lower court.
articles.body: A Texas woman can no longer be kept 500 feet away from her family's trust property after an appeals court overturned restrictions imposed by a lower court. The ruling, delivered on November 10, came in a dispute involving Jensen Chelsea Anderson, her aunt Suzanne Tolbert Sakiewicz and Suzanne's husband, Edward P. Sakiewicz.The restrictions had prevented Anderson from approaching the trust's property in Gonzales, Texas. She was also barred from going near Suzanne and Edward, handling assets belonging to the trust or claiming that she had the authority to act on its behalf. The appeals court has now removed these restrictions after finding that the order imposing them did not follow mandatory legal procedures.According to the judgment, the dispute centres on the Barbara Tolbert Revocable Trust. Suzanne is Barbara Tolbert's daughter and a co-trustee, while Anderson is Barbara's granddaughter. Both have claimed an interest in the trust as beneficiaries. However, the appeals court made no ruling on either claim and did not decide who should receive the trust assets.The family disagreement had already reached court in 2023. Suzanne's brother, Gordon Gerald Tolbert, who is also a co-trustee, had sued Suzanne, Edward and an associated company, Sakabbage LLC. He accused them of misconduct relating to the trust. Suzanne subsequently filed a counterclaim against Gordon. Those claims remain part of the wider dispute and were not decided in Anderson's appeal.Dispute over Texas property brings granddaughter into caseAnderson's involvement in the legal proceedings became an issue in June 2024. Suzanne then alleged that her niece had improperly moved into a property owned by the trust in Gonzales.Suzanne asked the court to protect the property through a temporary injunction. Her filing also raised concerns about Gordon's performance of his responsibilities as co-trustee. However, it did not directly seek an order against Anderson.At that point, Anderson was not a party to the lawsuit and had not appeared before the trial court. The court initially granted Suzanne's request for an injunction, but that restriction later expired under its own terms.The matter took a different turn in April 2026, when Suzanne and Edward filed another application. This time, they specifically sought restrictions against Anderson.Their application sought to stop her from presenting herself as a trustee, dealing with trust assets or spending money belonging to the trust. They also wanted her to hand over access to properties she held and provide a sworn account of business she had conducted while claiming to act as a trustee.Suzanne and Edward further asked the court to impose sanctions on Anderson and make her pay their legal expenses. Anderson filed her answer and counterclaim on May 11, 2026.Lower court imposed restrictions on AndersonThe trial court heard the application on May 14. After hearing arguments from Suzanne and Edward's lawyer and taking limited testimony from Anderson, the judge decided to grant the requested injunction.The written order went beyond restricting Anderson's dealings with trust assets. It also prohibited her from approaching the Gonzales property within 500 feet. The same distance restriction applied to Suzanne and Edward.Anderson was barred from interfering with the property. This included changing its locks, disconnecting security cameras or utility services, and causing damage. She was also prohibited from taking possession of any property held by the trust or trying to exercise control over it.The order prevented her from keeping Suzanne and Edward out of the Gonzales property. It also barred her from telling others that she had authority to act under the trust or that she was a beneficiary.Although the order described these restrictions as permanent, the appeals court later examined the circumstances in which they had been imposed. Anderson challenged the decision on May 28, 2026.Appeals court explains why the order could not standThe Fourth Court of Appeals in San Antonio examined whether the lower court had followed the rules required for granting an injunction.A key issue was the nature of the May 14 order. Although the trial court had described the restrictions as permanent, the appeals judges looked at when and why they were imposed.The application filed by Suzanne and Edward had sought temporary relief. The restrictions also came into force while the main family lawsuit was still pending. No final decision had been made in that case.The appeals court therefore treated the order as a temporary injunction. This allowed it to examine Anderson's challenge before the entire family dispute had reached a final decision.The judges then found two important omissions in the lower court's order. Under Texas Rule of Civil Procedure 683, a temporary injunction must include a date for the trial that will decide the main issues in the case.This requirement is intended to ensure that temporary restrictions do not continue indefinitely without a full hearing on the dispute.Another provision, Rule 684, requires the applicants to provide security, with the court specifying the amount. The May 14 order did not include such an amount.The appeals court found that the lower court's order had neither fixed a trial date nor stated the required security amount. These were not optional details. Both rules set out compulsory conditions for granting a temporary injunction.Suzanne and Edward argued that Anderson had not raised the objections at the appropriate stage. However, the appeals judges noted that she had already submitted a written objection concerning the absence of the required cash bond.The court also pointed out that an injunction failing to meet the requirements of Rule 683 could be invalid even if the affected person had not specifically raised that objection.Court sends case back for further proceedingsThe appeals court accepted Anderson's challenge to the procedural defects. It ruled that the May 14 order was void and could not remain in force.The judges reversed the lower court's order, dissolved the injunction and sent the matter back to the trial court for further proceedings.Anderson had raised four other challenges to the restrictions. However, the appeals court did not examine them because its decision on the first issue was sufficient to dispose of the appeal.You use AI every day. Now get your AI Quotient. Take the AIQ test.

articles.title: Sudden death of 27-year-old daughter of British actress Lisa Maxwell in New York. Columbia University issues statement
articles.summary: Beau Jessup, the 27-year-old daughter of British actress Lisa Maxwell, has died unexpectedly while pursuing a master's degree in journalism at Columbia
articles.body: Beau Jessup, the 27-year-old daughter of British actress Lisa Maxwell, has died unexpectedly while pursuing a master's degree in journalism at Columbia University in New York. While no other details of her death have been disclosed, the sudden passing of Jessup was confirmed by a statement from the university. "Columbia Journalism School mourns the loss of Beau Jessup, a student in our M.S. program. We extend our deepest condolences to her family, friends, classmates and all who knew and loved her. The J-School is working with Beau’s family to offer support and assistance during this difficult time," Columbia Journalism School where she was studying master's, said in the statement. She was expected to graduate in May 2027.Before moving to New York, Jessup studied social anthropology at the London School of Economics and writing for performance at the University of Cambridge. During her time at Cambridge, she wrote a play titled 'The Sandbag'. She had also made a name for herself as a young entrepreneur. In 2016, when she was a teenager, Jessup founded SpecialName, a website that helped Chinese parents choose English names for their children.The service reportedly helped more than 250,000 children and earned her approximately £48,000.Jessup had spoken about how growing up with a famous mother influenced her interest in journalism. She said her upbringing made her curious about who gets to tell people's stories and how those stories can sometimes be distorted in the public eye. She hoped to pursue reporting on people, culture and social issues while continuing to write for theatre.The Dean of Columbia Journalism School, Jelani Cobb, also sent an email to the students and acknowledged how "painful it is to receive messages like this one." "Any loss within our school family is difficult to process, and our thoughts and deepest condolences go out to Beau’s family and friends during this heartbreaking time," he wrote, calling Beau a "cherished member" of the community.Beau gave an interview with Columbia in the week before her death, and they shared it publicly with permission from her family."I grew up with an unusual awareness of the distance between people’s lives and the stories told about them. I saw how journalism could illuminate someone’s experiences, but also how those experiences could be distorted, simplified, or transformed into a public narrative over which the subject had very little control," she said in that interview. "I was curious, from quite a young age, about who gets to tell people’s stories, and what happens when those stories enter the public domain.You use AI every day. Now get your AI Quotient. articles.title: Kanel Joseph calls out ‘contentless’ Kick streamers after spotting isdurpyy in IShowSpeed costume
articles.summary: Kick streamer Kanel Joseph confronted fellow content creator isdurpyy after spotting him dressed as popular YouTuber Darren “IShowSpeed” with his face
articles.body: Kick streamer Kanel Joseph confronted fellow content creator isdurpyy after spotting him dressed as popular YouTuber Darren “IShowSpeed” with his face darkened to match the streamer’s skin tone. The incident happened while Kanel was sitting in his car at a red light. isdurpyy approached him to say hello, but the conversation soon took a different turn. Kanel criticized the smaller creator for using the costume to make content and told him to come up with better ideas. He also questioned the kind of content some Kick streamers make.Kanel Joseph Questions isdurpyy After Seeing Him Dressed as IShowSpeedThe incident was shared by industry reporter FearBuck (@FearedBuck) on X. The video showed isdurpyy walking down the street while dressed like IShowSpeed. His outfit included a Portugal No. 7 jersey, but the dark makeup on his face made the costume more controversial.According to the clip, isdurpyy noticed Kanel sitting in his car and walked over to greet him.He said:"Kanel! Wassup, bro? How are you doing?"Kanel then asked whether he was trying to look like IShowSpeed. isdurpyy replied:"I am Speed."However, Kanel did not seem impressed with the costume. He questioned why some Kick streamers relied on such ideas to create content.He said:"This is what these Kick streamers do, man. They don't got no content."The exchange was particularly noticeable because isdurpyy was a much smaller creator compared to Kanel. According to the supplied platform figures, isdurpyy had around 350 followers on Kick, while Kanel had about 840,000 followers on Twitch and averaged roughly 2,000 viewers per stream.The use of dark makeup to imitate another person's skin colour is commonly known as blackface. It has a long history of racist performances and is considered offensive. Dressing up as a popular creator does not make that part of the costume harmless.Kanel Joseph Tells isdurpyy to Make Better Content After Their Street EncounterKanel continued speaking to isdurpyy and made it clear that he did not think the smaller streamer was creating original content.Interestingly, Kanel also reminded him that he was a Kick streamer himself. He said that being on the same platform did not mean he agreed with the way isdurpyy was trying to get attention.He explained:"It's okay, though. I'm on the same platform, but you gon' learn, man."Kanel then told him that he was struggling to find content ideas and needed to put more effort into his work.He added:"You're just scrambling and scraping for content, but it's okay. No one's going to remember this. You gotta make better content, bro."After hearing Kanel's comments, isdurpyy walked away from the car. However, the conversation did not end there.One of his associates later asked whether he was going to let Kanel speak to him that way. isdurpyy did not appear to have a response ready and simply said:"What was I supposed to say?"The clip does not show any further argument between the two streamers.Kanel Joseph has also been involved in other public disagreements with fellow creators. In October 2026, he was part of a physical altercation with another streamer at Ice Poseidon's Safe Zone event in Austin. That incident also drew attention after footage of the encounter appeared online.For this latest exchange, however, the focus remained on isdurpyy's IShowSpeed costume and Kanel's criticism of his content. FearBuck shared the footage on X on November 10, 2026.You use AI every day. Now get your AI Quotient. Take the AIQ test.
